ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own page and link to it from the list, with a short summary
ideas.why: Blog items are plain text titles with no URLs, so there is nothing specific for crawlers or readers to reach.

ideas.idea: Add a server layout for /blog with its own title and description
ideas.why: Blog has no metadata and inherits the home title; as a client component it can't export metadata, so this is accurate and concrete.

ideas.idea: Expand Docs with actual setup steps as text, and link onward to Pricing
ideas.why: Docs is one sentence while its description promises 'How to set up Ledger', so the content doesn't match.

ideas.idea: List plans and prices as text on Pricing and optionally add Product/Offer structured data
ideas.why: Pricing says only 'Free for up to three people' while its description promises plans for every team size.

ideas.idea: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD using the name and URL from layout
ideas.why: Accurate since no JSON-LD exists, but it's a standard suggestion that applies to nearly any site and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Add openGraph metadata for social previews
ideas.why: Accurate that none is set, but it applies to almost any site and does little for search or AI discovery.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap, or generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: Valid but low-impact for a four-URL site, and the report itself says to add dates only once real ones exist.

ideas.idea: Link home page features to Docs and link Pricing from the home page body
ideas.why: The home page body has no links, so internal linking only comes from the nav; this is accurate and specific.

ideas.idea: If Pricing should be private, drop it from the sitemap and the canonical
ideas.why: It's the conditional half of the known pricing noindex conflict, so it adds nothing new.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical to Blog via a small server layout
ideas.why: It repeats the known missing-canonical problem, with the Blog angle already covered by the blog layout idea.
